notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hi all,

finally the 1.3 update is here! We are excited to announce all the new features introduced thanks to your feedback:

- custom timer for all games (finally! :D)
- new enemy monster (The Gigant!) with unique mechanics
- new map-modules to exend the maze (and get lost easly :P)
- added the possibility to bind movement keys
- added the poossibility to invert camera settings 
- added Steam trading cards***

We would be happy to receive your feedback again! Let us know what you think about the new update in the Sleeping Dawn comunity.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31036065/3979505ba4ce5cc9e393ec1ece3620045969b2a7.png

*** Trading Cards need Steam approval so it is likely that they will not be available immediately!

Effimera Studio

notes.title: [ComingSoon] Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hi all,

thanks again to everyone for the support that you are constantly showing us by buying, playing and reviewing Sleeping Dawn. Thanks to all your reports, we are pleased to announce that a big update is planned for January. It will include various changes requested by the community:

- modifier on the game timer
- new enemy
- changes to the game map
- various fix and greater stability on multiplayer mode

Staty tuned for more!

Effimera Studio

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31036065/251bbfcf910e79d12c0f54edb291cfcfe983e5d6.png

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hi, 
thanks to your tips we have added new features to Sleeping Dawn. And here it is the update 1.2! It includes: 

- sound effect while using chalk 
- difficulty level selector in both singleplayer and multiplayer mode at the beginning of the games (difficulty affects the size of the maze)
- minor bug fix

Thanks,
Effimera Studio

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
First of all THANK YOU to anyone who has already bought Sleeping Dawn! Thank you for your trust and your interest in our first game. We are really excited about all of this!
We've listened to your suggestions and critics that led to this little game update that includes:

- tips at the start point on how to deal with the maze and its mechanics
- bug fixing

We invite everyone to leave feedback on both the store page and the community page.

Thanks,
Effimera Studio
